Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating contracting standards of home care agencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to home care agencies; and adding new sections tochapter 74.39A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.39A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall not contract with any home care agency, asdefined in RCW 70.127.010, that has been found by the department oflabor and industries or a court of competent jurisdiction to haveviolated any provision of chapters 39.12, 49.46, and 49.48 RCW, unlessthe department finds that denying a contract would seriously inhibitthe state's ability to provide vulnerable and elderly residents withquality communitybased home care. In order for the department tocontract with an otherwise ineligible agency pursuant to this chapter,the department must determine that the agency's violation or violationsinvolved: (1) Very few employees; (2) a de minimus amount of wages peraffected employee; and (3) a firsttime or incidental offense. Thedepartment shall not allow an exception, in any case, when the agency'sviolation or violations would have resulted in material financial gainto the agency.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.39A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A home care agency licensed under chapter 70.127 RCW shall notsubcontract with any agency or individual to provide care to a client. (2) A home care agency shall not employ, or be reimbursed for, afamily member of a client who provides care for the client. (3) For the purposes of this section, "family member" includes aparent, child, sibling, aunt, uncle, or cousin of the client.
